notes: The Nano 33 BLE / BLE Sense is not in the catalogue, so a new type arduino-nano-33-ble was created. The USB connections have no named port.

The circuit image shows wires and resistors joined directly with no breadboard drawn. The manual lists mini breadboards, so one breadboard (bb1) is used as the junction for the two pull-up resistors and the shared SDA/SCL lines.
Breadboard holes were chosen arbitrarily. SDA (A4) lines share strip 10t, SCL (A5) lines share strip 12t, and the 3V3 line goes to the top positive rail (tp), which is a single strip.
SDA is on A4 and SCL is on A5 on both boards. Each 4.7 kΩ resistor pulls one line up to 3V3.
GND is a direct wire between the two boards. Both boards are powered by USB from the computer.
Only one wire carries 3V (reader 3V3). The writer's 3V3 is not connected.
Reader is a Nano 33 BLE Sense (built-in LED is toggled). Writer is a Nano 33 BLE per the editor screenshot.
